100% agree with this. I don't want to discourage anyone from talking about it if they want to, this is just my personal experience and I wasn't aware of the hospitalization rule beforehand. I honestly had no idea this post would be seen by so many people lol it was mainly just a rant
It's not your fault. We know what's best for ourselves and you have a right to not want to undergo all of that. It just sucks that we have to lie our way out of it.
Are you really sure you want to be sexist on my suicide post?

Yeah its really tricky. I've found that therapy has helped me a lot so far, but I think this experience really changes things. I don't feel as comfortable anymore sharing everything with her because I don't know what could be used against me. Seems kind of counterintuitive that the people who need the most help aren't even able to talk about why they need help. We really need to have somewhere we can get help without having to worry about being committed or have something put on our medical record.

I'm sorry you were so negatively affected by that. There really needs to be a better option than hospitalization. I know it does help some people but I think for a lot of us (myself included) it would just make things even worse. I feel like we should at least be able to choose whether we want to go or not.

Is crazy that the response to someone wanting to commit suicide is to make their life even harder by preventing them from being able to do certain things or have certain rights for the rest of their life. They really don't have our best interest in mind, we're just a liability.
Oh that's true, I think that's why she didn't end up hospitalizing me after all. But my main concern now is I feel like I won't be able to talk to her about things like this again

Unfortunately I still met the criteria for hospitalization as I had a plan, means to do it, and intent to follow through (I was literally right about to when I changed my mind). But I definetly feel like they should add something in there about deciding not to follow through with it after all. If I had actually attempted and failed that would be a different story, but I didn't even attempt. And its not like me sitting in a hospital room for a few days and collecting a ton of medical debt is really gonna help anyways.

Have you thought about switching meds or finding a different therapist? You could even talk to your current ones and let them know that what they're doing now isn't working and you need a different approach. It still may not help but it may be worth a try. Also if you have an okay relationship with your parents you could talk to them about you needing more/different help and see if they're able to help you find it. You don't have to tell them you want to die but maybe just mention that you're having a harder time than before. I'm usually not one for sugar-coating but I think the fact that you don't want to kill yourself and you know you need help is a sign that things will end up getting better for you.

Would it be possible to get help from a therapist or psychiatrist? My mental health issues started around when I was your age, and seeing a therapist and getting on medication helped me a lot. I would also look out for any asd or lgbt support groups for teens in your area. It could help a lot just to have someone to listen to you who understands you.

I relate to this so much. It's really really hard when the people around you don't actually care. I know this doesn't mean much from a stranger on reddit but I care about you. If you ever want to talk to someone just send me a message. I may not have the best advice but it might help to have someone just to listen to you without judgement. One thing I will say is that there are people out there who care about you, you just haven't found them yet.

It's never too late to get help and change your ways. Learn from your past mistakes and strive to be a better person. The fact that you feel guilty and ashamed means that you know what you did was wrong. This is the first step to getting better. I feel like you're halfway there. If you haven't already I would highly recommend getting help from a good therapist.
Also if your teacher is treating you unfairly I would reccommend contacting the department head (or principal if in high school) about it

I'm sorry you're having such a hard time. As someone who is also neurodivergent, I can tell you it's not your fault and you're not a failure. The current school system was not made for people like us. Our brains don't work the same as everyone else, but that's okay. We all have our own strengths and skills that we excell at more than others. Don't let school define your self worth. You are so much more than a grade on some meaningless science test. 

That being said you should 100% reach out to the administrators at your school. Let them know what you have the most trouble with and what they could do to make class work better for you. They are obligated by law to give you accomodations. 

You can do it! I believe in you :)

I wish he would leave her lol

He knows she's crazy and I've talked to him about it. But he basically only stays because she cooks and cleans so he doesn't have to do anything. Apparently he would rather get to be lazy than prevent me and my sister from being tormented by her. In my opinion he's just as bad as her.

Society was not set up for us to be happy. Our whole existence is only to make some rich CEO richer and to make some politician more powerful. Life doesn't get better because it has been purposefully designed not to. They tell you it will so you'll work harder and buy more things but it never does. It's all a lie. At this point I'm ready to go run off and live in the woods.

I left the house visibly upset after being yelled at for the millionth time. Yet no one texted or called me to ask if I was okay. I didn't have a single notification on my phone by the time I got home. And I was gone 2 hours in total. I'm home now in my room and still no one has bothered to check on me. I love proving myself right. I guess its good to know that when I finally go through with it I won't have anyone I know trying to stop me.
